root_cause_verification.rationale: Two specific issues fixed: (1) showsHorizontalScrollIndicator was truthy (bare attribute = true), changed to explicit {false}; (2) container lacked bottom border radius, added borderBottomLeftRadius/Right: 11 with overflow: hidden to clip content to rounded shape
